name: ブラインド画像品質評価 (BRISQUE)
description: 使用します natural scene statistics to evaluate image quality and detect distortions を示す AI generation or 操作.
mechanism: Computes locally normalized luminance 係数 and fits them to a generalized Gaussian 分布. The shape and 分散 parameters are used as 特徴 を検出するために deviations from natural image statistics.
parameters: Patch size: 7×7, MSCN 係数, GGD fitting, Features: 36-dimensional, SVR model
source: Mittal, A. et al. (2012) — No-Reference Image Quality Assessment in the Spatial Domain, IEEE TIP
useCase: Evaluating naturalness of images to flag AI生成の or heavily processed content

references.title: Mittal, A. et al. (2012) — No-Reference Image Quality Assessment in the Spatial Domain, IEEE TIP

strengths:
• 参照画像不要
• Fast computation
• Correlates well with human perception
• 検出します multiple distortion types
limitations:
• May not detect high-quality AI images
• Sensitive to legitimate processing
• Requires calibration per domain
• Not specific to any 偽造 type
